mapping_notes.included_rows: Only CardioBoost holdout rows whose gene symbol appears in the local 57-gene training cohort.
mapping_notes.population_frequency: gnomad_max_af uses gnomAD_AF when available, otherwise AF_Adj. gnomad_status is 'matched' when either is available, otherwise 'absent'.
mapping_notes.hgvs_mapping: gene_refgene preserves the original CardioBoost transcript-qualified HGVSc token. hgvs_c strips the transcript prefix. hgvs_p is normalized and hgvs_p_one_letter is derived with the local annotation helper.
mapping_notes.unsupported_model_feature_policy: Fields without a valid CardioBoost analogue were left empty for numeric inputs and set to 'Missing' for categorical inputs.
mapping_notes.deduplication: The deduplicated file removes exact duplicate gene+position+REF+ALT variants that appear in both disease panels. Duplicate panels were retained in cardioboost_duplicate_panels.
